theorems.name: Submission.dorag_th_trace_comp_fderiv_test_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξ x : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ζ y ^ 2 • ((y - ξ) - S.starProjection (y - ξ))) x).toLinearMap) = ζ x ^ 2 * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - S.starProjection).toLinearMap) + 2 * ζ x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (T.starProjection ((x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
